subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: Should the core model-facing `write` tool gain an opt-in `append` mode as the supported solution for the linked data-loss workflow?
rationale: Source review can determine implementation safety, but cannot decide whether append should become a permanent core write-tool contract rather than a separate tool or another supported workflow.

options.title: Approve append on write
options.body: Keep `append?: boolean` and require consistent atomic semantics across every backend before merge.

options.title: Choose a separate surface
options.body: Reject this API shape and place the capability in a distinct append tool or another owner-approved workflow.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Pause or close the PR until a maintainer sponsors a core append direction.

recommendation.title: Approve append on write
recommendation.body: Keep `append?: boolean` and require consistent atomic semantics across every backend before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history connects Peter to the composed write-tool and mutation-queue surface where the product contract is exposed.
